text: …　だからさ　ポケモン　ずかん　かんせい　したら　ぼくに　くれない？

structure.jp: ポケモン　ずかん　かんせい　したら

structure.en: won't you give it to me?

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'when' or 'once' that thing has happened. かんせい したら = 'when you've completed it'.

patterns.name: 〜ないか
patterns.explanation: A 'not' form said as a question is a soft way to ask for something, like 'won't you?'. くれない？ = 'won't you give it to me?'.
